#include <iostream>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

bool isEven(int number) {
    return number % 2 == 0;
}

int main() {
    string dna;
    cin >> dna;
    int answer = 0;
    int counter = 1;
    char previous = dna[0];

    for (size_t i = 1; i < dna.length(); i++) {
        char current = dna[i];
        if (previous != current) {
            previous = current;
            continue;
        }
        counter++;
        if (i == dna.length() - 1) {
            if (isEven(counter)) {
                answer++;
                counter = 1;
            }
        } else if (dna[i + 1] != previous && isEven(counter)) {
            answer++;
            counter = 1;
        }
    }

    cout << answer << endl;
    return 0;
}
